dog.description_text:
Meet Fawn!

Fawn has a curious mind and a fun loving personality. She enjoys watching the world around her and especially likes keeping an eye on the people and things nearby, she’s always interested in what’s happening!

When it’s time for some fun, Fawn loves chasing lasers and playing with mouse toys. She’s also a big fan of yummy treats, making snack time another great way to brighten her day.

If you’re looking for a curious companion who enjoys people watching, playtime, and tasty treats, Fawn is ready to meet you!

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 6 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
